title: orders.order.placed
description: An order was placed at checkout. Lines ride the event (ids, quantities and prices only — no contact or address) so a product owner can decrement stock and a seller can be told. Key = order id. Money is a decimal string. attempt_key links the order to the checkout-hook reservations of its attempt.

actor_id.description: The acting account id (guest or not) — the same actor_id the adjusters and checkout hooks saw. user_id here is the account id as stored, a guest's included. Sent since 0.2.0; optional for consumers of older emitters.

attempt_key.description: The checkout idempotency key (lowercase hyphenated UUID) — the attempt_key the checkout hooks saw. Sent since 0.2.0; optional for consumers of older emitters.
